name: Bull Rush
author: voodoo573
description: Feat from Level Up: Advanced 5th Edition. Your headlong rush devastates your foes. After dashing (with the Dash Action) at least ten feet towards a foe, you may perform a bonus action to select one of the following options. Attack. Make one melee weapon attack, dealing an extra 5 damage on a hit. Shove. Use the Shove maneuver, pushing the target 10 feet directly away on a success.
summary: After a Dash toward a foe, use a bonus action for a hard-hitting attack (+5 damage) or a 10-ft shove.
